description: Furnished apartment with 3 bedrooms and 110 m2, located on the 4th floor of a luxury building on a very quiet street 2 steps from the Arc de Triomphe.Enjoying an exceptional, safe and family-friendly location, it is located in the heart of the Golden Triangle, a 2-minute walk from Place de l'Etoile, 5 minutes from the Champs Elysées and close to many transport options and restaurants.The spaceWith its ideal and functional layout, it includes an entrance, a large living/dining room, a dining kitchen, 3 independent bedrooms (including 2 bedrooms overlooking a completely silent wooded courtyard), 2 bathrooms (1 with shower and the other with bathtub), 2 toilets. • Bedroom 1: 1 double bed 160 x 200• Bedroom 2: 1 double bed 160 x 200• Bedroom 2: 1 single bed 100 x 190 (+ 1 inflatable bed for 1 person available if needed as 6th bed)Fully equipped apartment (fiber Wi-Fi, TV, washing machine, dryer, kitchen, etc.) in a secure building with elevator.Other things to noteThe apartment is located close to all the transport necessary for a tourist stay, for shopping and close to many Olympic sites:• Main metro lines (lines 1, 2, 6 and RER A)• Taxi stations• Bus to the airportNo pets or parties allowed.A cleaning lady will take care of the daily cleaning of the apartment.
